content.what_it_is: MATLAB script for the beach_2d_radiation case: plots the cross-shore momentum-balance terms output by FUNWAVE's radiation-stress diagnostics. Loads snapshot num=3 (fnum @L5) of twelve mean fields from output/ (L6-L18): x-terms PgrdX (pressure gradient), FRCX (friction), radiation-stress gradients DxSxx and DySxy, advective-flux gradients DxUUH and DyUVH; y-terms PgrdY, FRCY, DySyy, DxSxy, DyVVH, DxUVH. Plots row ny=25 @L21 of each term along the grid: subplot 211 x-balance (L24-L35, legend @L32), subplot 212 y-balance (L37-L48, legend @L45), units label 'm^2/s^2'; saves balance.jpg @L50.
entities: script; variables: fdir @L1; num @L4; fnum @L5; PgrdX @L6; FRCX @L7; DxSxx @L8; DySxy @L9; DxUUH @L10; DyUVH @L11; PgrdY @L13; FRCY @L14; DySyy @L15; DxSxy @L16; DyVVH @L17; DxUVH @L18; ny @L21
calls: builtins: sprintf, load, figure/clf/subplot, plot, hold, legend, grid, xlabel/ylabel, print
unresolved: No clear all at top — relies on a clean workspace; the twelve mean/radiation fields (OUT_Radiation etc.) must have been enabled in the FUNWAVE input for these files to exist; x-axis is grid index (no dx scaling) and ny=25 is case-specific
